arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cards_with_same_timestamp_pair FROM (SELECT card_id FROM transactions GROUP BY card_id, date HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 GROUP BY card_id)
arguments.explanation: Counts the cards that have at least one pair of transactions sharing an identical timestamp.
assumptions: 'Exactly the same timestamp' means the same full date value to the second, as stored in transactions.date.
All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label.
Each card is counted once, however many timestamp collisions it has.
